system.tactics:
They use POUNCE from the shadows to leap into zones, followed by BITE to grapple and chew their prey.

Party scaling. Fewer than 4 Delvers: remove 2 gillybelches from the Parlor. More than 4: add one Brute Gillybelch per additional Delver.
system.tagline: These snot-covered toads leap at anything that moves, then latch on with glass shard teeth and chew their victim mercilessly.

abilities.name: HORROR
abilities.description: While unwarded, your tests are -1M easier and tests targeting you are +1M harder.

abilities.name: AMPHIBIOUS
abilities.description: You aren't slowed by water. You can breathe both water and air.

actions.name: BITE
actions.boons: Spend 1 boon to grapple the target. While grappling, you cannot bite other creatures.

actions.name: POUNCE
actions.description: Leap into the zone of an enemy within 2 range. If unsuccessful, you may still move normally.
